api.split_config: split_config(cfg) removes master and dense_teacher_* keys in place; validates unknown/invalid options even while OFF; returns resolved config or None
api.plan_config: plan_config(cfg=None) resolves a copy without mutating the caller
api.factory_B: make_teacher(cfg, planner_kwargs={'rollout': cpu_rollout, 'calibration': fitted_calibration, 'config': optional_T1B_Config, 'calibrate': optional_T1C_function}) -> WMDenseTeacher
api.planner_adapter: planner_scorer(...) binds planner_online.score_moves(record, rng, rollout=..., calibration=..., config=..., calibrate=..., move_api=...). Its fixed candidate provider prevents re-sampling. It maps p_calibrated/expected_gain into the local p_better/gain seam without changing horizon or WM samples.
api.label: teacher.label_state(episode, step, t_s, cav, obs_state, candidates=None) -> provenance-rich label. Pass the actual TriggerBatch.tables[i] as candidates for T2A training. None means draw from T1A for standalone labelling.
api.capture: DAggerBuffer(cadence_s).add(episode, step, t_s, cav, obs_state, candidates=recorded_table) snapshots observable state/table at decision ticks; deduplicates identities. buffer.label(teacher) labels new records once and aggregates earlier labels.
api.CE: trigger_targets(labels, batch) -> candidate indices in batch.context['members'] order; checks exact recorded support and masks. Feed directly into TriggerPolicy.imitation_loss(batch, targets).
api.target_encoding: candidate_class 0 is none, i+1 selects candidates[i] including exact partners and parameters. TargetEncoder also exposes a fixed family/parameter-bucket action_class with explicit members as an auxiliary target. Use candidate_class, not action_class, for the concrete T2A head.
api.verification_selection: select_for_verification(labels, fraction) uses a deterministic, order-independent hash Bernoulli subset over label identities
api.verification_driver: verify_selected(labels, fraction, submit_first_seed, verifier, moves_mod=None); submit_first_seed(label) returns (sealed_receipt, candidate_index, plan), or (sealed_receipt, None, None) for none. Existing bound labels are never dispatched again.
api.verification_binding: bind_receipt checks receipt seal, completed status, selected label, training episode/time identity, candidate plan digest, members and moves.from_plan projection; no unrelated plan can silently certify a label
api.all8: All8Verifier(root, arm, runner_for, run_root, phase, workers=2, extra_seeds=0, health=None).flush() delegates to verify_perseed.confirm_pending_all8. consume(labels) verifies bound receipt/plan identities and attaches per-seed outcomes.
api.budget: verification_quote(labels, k, duration_s=None, members=4, end_s=1200, extra_seeds=0) delegates to verify_perseed.quote_decision; default duration is maximum registered onset+hold; assumes all candidates admitted on both seeds, including solos/extra seeds
api.dataset: build_dataset(labels, encoder) returns CE rows, observable inputs, exact supports, full resumable labels, counts and histogram. save_dataset/load_dataset use canonical JSON and a content seal.

semantics.B_selection: Require calibrated p_better >= p_star and strictly positive expected gain; maximize gain among eligible candidates; stable candidate-order ties; otherwise none
semantics.lookahead: Concrete T1B adapter retains the registered full 600-second look-ahead and paired WM sample count; move duration never screens or shortens this forecast
semantics.R_fairness: Same T1A candidate generator, budget, registered parameter windows, visible-member checks and optional recorded table as B; independent choice RNG leaves the candidate RNG stream unchanged. R draws uniformly from candidate support plus none, without WM scoring. The candidate proposal distribution, not the WM-selected label marginal, is matched.
semantics.observables: Allowlisted sensing/V2V rows, observable length, local group/commands/residuals/history, actor-only policy state and existing commitments. Hidden row extras and unknown top-level fields are stripped before capture, candidate generation and scoring. T2C must supply the acting CAV's actual local/t-1 observable view; T1B also validates sensing range and belief completeness.
semantics.DAgger: Capture the current learner's own rollout decision states and actual candidate tables; do not substitute bank/expert state trajectories
semantics.SUMO_fraction: The configured fraction is a deterministic Bernoulli sampling rate, not an exact rounded count per small batch; selected and measured counts are separately visible in receipts
semantics.verified_meaning: verified means the bound decision has a measured sealed all8 record, including rejected cases. verified_replicated requires admission on both seeds 1/2. The teacher target is retained and realised admission/cooperation/flip flags are recorded; verification is not silently represented as success.
semantics.none_verification: None binds to the measured policy-continues comparator; no fabricated candidate admission is reported
semantics.all8_path: Existing both-CRN candidate+reference, own-seed extended later-harm, solo/group cooperation and extra-seed machinery; existing charge-before-physics and health hooks are inherited unchanged

T2C_integration: Resolve teacher config per arm; B uses WMDenseTeacher with explicit CPU rollout and fitted calibration; R uses RandomTeacher with the identical candidate budget/fraction and no WM arguments.
At registered learner decision ticks, capture local belief plus each CAV's recorded T2A candidate table through DAggerBuffer.add, then aggregate labels.

For each selected state, submit_first_seed must use the existing bank runner to persist the decision/snapshot and run its ordinary ledger/health guarded candidate verification. For none, still verify candidate support against policy-continues. Keep dispatch serialized with the bank supervisor.

Use verify_selected/All8Verifier to finish and consume existing all8 confirmations, with the same extra_seeds and hooks for B/R. Reuse persisted verification bindings after restart instead of starting new jobs.

Use trigger_targets on the corresponding original TriggerBatch and apply TriggerPolicy.imitation_loss; save build_dataset output as the dense-label component receipt, including counts.selected/counts.verified/counts.replicated.
T2C owns live episode wiring, actual CPU WM/calibration objects, observable belief construction, first-seed plan construction/persistence and the owner-approved end-to-end launch.
